name: Windows - Security Analytics - User Authentication
description: Dashboard providing security analytics on successful and failed account logins.
title: Windows - Security Analytics - User Authentication

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/windows* "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" ("4770" OR "4771" OR "4772" OR "4776" OR "4777" OR "4768" OR "4769" OR "4820" OR "4625" OR "4624" OR "4647" OR "4778" OR "4779" OR "4800" OR "4801" OR "4802" OR "4803") "Audit Success" {{{Computer}}} {{{Subject}}} {{{Target}}} {{{IpAddress}}} {{{EventID}}}

| json "Channel", "Provider.Name", "EventID", "Computer", "Keywords", "Message" as Channel, Provider, EventID, Computer, Keywords, Message nodrop
| where Channel = "Security"
| where provider = "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"
| where EventID in ("4770", "4771", "4772", "4776", "4776", "4768", "4769", "4820", "4625", "4624", "4647", "4778", "4779", "4800", "4801", "4802","4803")
| where EventID matches "{{{EventID}}}"
| where Keywords = "Audit Success"
| where computer matches "{{{Computer}}}"

| json "EventData.TargetDomainName", "EventData.TargetUserName", "EventData.SubjectDomainName", "EventData.SubjectUserName", "EventData.IpAddress", "EventData.LogonType", "EventData.Status" as TargetDomainName, TargetUserName, SubjectDomainName, SubjectUserName, IpAddress, LogonType, Status nodrop
| where !(TargetUserName matches "*$")
| replace(IpAddress, "::ffff:", "") as IpAddress

| formatDate(_messageTime, "yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss") as date
| format("%s/%s", SubjectDomainName, SubjectUserName) as subject
| format("%s/%s", TargetDomainName, TargetUserName) as target
| parse field=Message "*\n" as message nodrop

| where subject matches "{{{Subject}}}"
| where target matches "{{{Target}}}"
| where IpAddress matches "{{{IpAddress}}}"

| "** Unknown **" as LogonDescription
| if(IsEmpty(LogonType), 0, LogonType) as LogonType
| if(LogonType=0, "N/A", LogonDescription) as LogonDescription
| if(LogonType=2, "Interactive", LogonDescription) as LogonDescription
| if(LogonType=3, "Network", LogonDescription) as LogonDescription
| if(LogonType=4, "Batch", LogonDescription) as LogonDescription
| if(LogonType=5, "Service", LogonDescription) as LogonDescription
| if(LogonType=7, "Unlock", LogonDescription) as LogonDescription
| if(LogonType=8, "NetworkCleartext", LogonDescription) as LogonDescription
| if(LogonType=9, "NewCredentials", LogonDescription) as LogonDescription
| if(LogonType=10, "RemoteInteractive", LogonDescription) as LogonDescription
| if(LogonType=11, "CachedInteractive", LogonDescription) as LogonDescription

| "** Unknown **" as StatusDescription
| if(IsEmpty(Status), "N/A", Status) as Status
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="N/A", "N/A", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC000005E", "There are currently no logon servers available to service the logon request.", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC0000064", "User logon with misspelled or bad user account", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC000006A", "User logon with misspelled or bad password", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC000006D", "The cause is either a bad username or authentication information", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC000006E", "Indicates a referenced user name and authentication information are valid, but some user account restriction has prevented successful authentication (such as time-of-day restrictions).", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC000006F", "User logon outside authorized hours", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC0000070", "User logon from unauthorized workstation", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC0000071", "User logon with expired password", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC0000072", "User logon to account disabled by administrator", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC00000DC", "Indicates the Sam Server was in the wrong state to perform the desired operation.", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC0000133", "Clocks between DC and other computer too far out of sync", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC000015B", "The user has not been granted the requested logon type (also called the logon right) at this machine", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC000018C", "The logon request failed because the trust relationship between the primary domain and the trusted domain failed.", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC0000192", "An attempt was made to logon, but the Netlogon service was not started.", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC0000193", "User logon with expired account", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC0000224", "User is required to change password at next logon", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC0000225", "Evidently a bug in Windows and not a risk", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC0000234", "User logon with account locked", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC00002EE", "Failure Reason: An Error occurred during Logon", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC0000413", "Logon Failure: The machine you are logging on to is protected by an authentication firewall. The specified account is not allowed to authenticate to the machine.", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription

| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X1", "KDC_ERR_NAME_EXP: Client's entry in KDC database has expired", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X2", "KDC_ERR_SERVICE_EXP: Server's entry in KDC database has expired", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X3", "KDC_ERR_BAD_PVNO: Requested Kerberos version number not supported", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X4", "KDC_ERR_C_OLD_MAST_KVNO: Client's key encrypted in old master key", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription

| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X6", "KDC_ERR_C_PRINCIPAL_UNKNOWN: Client not found in Kerberos database", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X7", "KDC_ERR_S_PRINCIPAL_UNKNOWN: Server not found in Kerberos database", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription

| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X9", "KDC_ERR_NULL_KEY: The client or server has a null key (master key)", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XA", "KDC_ERR_CANNOT_POSTDATE: Ticket (TGT) not eligible for postdating", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XB", "KDC_ERR_NEVER_VALID: Requested start time is later than end time", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XC", "KDC_ERR_POLICY: Requested start time is later than end time", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XD", "KDC_ERR_BADOPTION: KDC cannot accommodate requested option", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XE", "KDC_ERR_ETYPE_NOTSUPP: KDC has no support for encryption type", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0XF", "KDC_ERR_SUMTYPE_NOSUPP: KDC has no support for checksum type", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X10", "KDC_ERR_PADATA_TYPE_NOSUPP: KDC has no support for PADATA type (pre-authentication data)", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X11", "KDC_ERR_TRTYPE_NO_SUPP: KDC has no support for transited type", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X12", "KDC_ERR_CLIENT_REVOKED: Client’s credentials have been revoked", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X13", "KDC_ERR_SERVICE_REVOKED: Credentials for server have been revoked", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X14", "KDC_ERR_TGT_REVOKED: TGT has been revoked", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X15", "KDC_ERR_CLIENT_NOTYET: Client not yet valid—try again later", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X16", "KDC_ERR_SERVICE_NOTYET: Server not yet valid—try again later", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X17", "KDC_ERR_KEY_EXPIRED: Password has expired—change password to reset", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X18", "KDC_ERR_PREAUTH_FAILED: Pre-authentication information was invalid", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X19", "KDC_ERR_PREAUTH_REQUIRED: Additional pre-authentication required", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X1A", "KDC_ERR_SERVER_NOMATCH: KDC does not know about the requested server", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X1B", "KDC_ERR_MUST_USE_USER2USER: This error occurs because the service is missing an SPN.", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X1D", "KDC_ERR_SVC_UNAVAILABLE: KDC is unavailable", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X1F", "KRB_AP_ERR_BAD_INTEGRITY: Integrity check on decrypted field failed", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X20", "KRB_AP_ERR_TKT_EXPIRED: The ticket has expired", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X21", "KRB_AP_ERR_TKT_NYV: The ticket is not yet valid", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X22", "KRB_AP_ERR_REPEAT: The request is a replay", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X23", "KRB_AP_ERR_NOT_US: The ticket is not for us", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X24", "KRB_AP_ERR_BADMATCH: The ticket and authenticator do not match", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X25", "KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW: The clock skew is too great", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription

| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X27", "KRB_AP_ERR_BADVERSION: Protocol version numbers don't match (PVNO)", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X28", "KRB_AP_ERR_MSG_TYPE: Message type is unsupported", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X29", "KRB_AP_ERR_MODIFIED: Message stream modified and checksum didn't match", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X2A", "KRB_AP_ERR_BADORDER: Message out of order (possible tampering)", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X2C", "KRB_AP_ERR_BADKEYVER: Specified version of key is not available", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X2D", "KRB_AP_ERR_NOKEY: Service key not available", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X2E", "KRB_AP_ERR_MUT_FAIL: Mutual authentication failed", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X2F", "KRB_AP_ERR_BADDIRECTION: Incorrect message direction", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X30", "KRB_AP_ERR_METHOD: Alternative authentication method required", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X31", "KRB_AP_ERR_BADSEQ: Incorrect sequence number in message", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X32", "KRB_AP_ERR_INAPP_CKSUM: Inappropriate type of checksum in message (checksum may be unsupported)", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X33", "KRB_AP_PATH_NOT_ACCEPTED: Desired path is unreachable", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X34", "KRB_ERR_RESPONSE_TOO_BIG: Too much data", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X3C", "KRB_ERR_GENERIC: Generic error", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X3D", "KRB_ERR_FIELD_TOOLONG: Field is too long for this implementation", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X3E", "KDC_ERR_CLIENT_NOT_TRUSTED: The client trust failed or is not implemented", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X3F", "KDC_ERR_KDC_NOT_TRUSTED: The KDC server trust failed or could not be verified", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X40", "KDC_ERR_INVALID_SIG: The signature is invalid", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X41", "KDC_ERR_KEY_TOO_WEAK: A higher encryption level is needed", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X42", "KRB_AP_ERR_USER_TO_USER_REQUIRED: User-to-user authorization is required", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription
| if(ToUpperCase(Status)="0X43", "KRB_AP_ERR_NO_TGT: No TGT was presented or available", StatusDescription) as StatusDescription

| count as Total Date, Computer, EventID, Message, Subject, Target, Keywords, LogonType, LogonDescription,Status, StatusDescription, IPAddress
| order by Date
